title: Inert probe leaves worktrees registered in the live repo
what: The inert probe makes its worktree from a throwaway clone (or removes it in a finally and on a killed run), so nothing is registered in the live repo; relay doctor names and prunes leftover probe worktrees.
why: 28 Oct ~07:50 UTC: `git worktree list` in ~/relay shows 20 detached worktrees under the macOS temp folder (tmp*/wt), each HEAD an 'inert probe' commit by relay-ci; 9 still exist (2-4 days old, clean), 11 point at deleted folders. A test or the gate's inert probe registers its worktree in the live repo and does not remove it when it ends or is killed. The rule: tests use a temporary folder and never touch the live repo.
failing_case: After a gate run, `git -C ~/relay worktree list` has a new tmp*/wt entry that stays after the gate ends.
pass_cases: A gate run leaves `git worktree list` as it found it.
A probe killed mid-run leaves no registered worktree after the next relay doctor.

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)
